name: PostgreSQL Truth Vault
purpose: Create the canonical PostgreSQL truth layer for candidates, applications, commands, workflow runs, evidence, source authority, heartbeat, DLQ, and RLS discipline.
truth_laws: PostgreSQL is the source of truth.
n8n is a thin worker only.
Every command must have idempotency protection.
Every important action must create evidence.
Workflow results must be recorded exactly once.
Source authority must track confidence bands.
Sensitive candidate data must be protected.
RLS is required before production exposure.
